metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the complete LAS 1.4 inspector/renderer in [main.js](/workspace/output/main.js).

It supports `inspect` and `render` via `node output/main.js --input <path> --output <path>`, uses only the Node.js standard library, and enforces LAS 1.4 structure for the public header, VLRs/EVLRs, CRS records, point formats 0–10, waveform descriptors/data references, and Extra Bytes metadata. Standard `LASF_Spec` and `LASF_Projection` records are parsed structurally and rejected as `invalid_document` when malformed or contradictory, rather than being downgraded to opaque metadata.

I verified it with local end-to-end cases for:
- WKT-based format 6 round-trip
- GeoTIFF-based format 3 round-trip
- internal waveform EVLR round-trip with point format 9
- Extra Bytes VLR plus per-point extra bytes round-trip
- malformed WKT inspection failure
- invalid render dataset failure and exit code `1`

No external files or dependencies were added.
